question: A storage tank is initially 3/8 full. After 55 liters are added it is 5/6 full. No liquid leaves the tank. What is the tank's total capacity in liters? Show the consistency check.
Find the smallest integer n greater than 100 such that n leaves remainder 3 when divided by 7 and remainder 4 when divided by 5. Verify both remainders.

Four sealed samples W, X, Y, and Z are processed one at a time. W must precede Y. X must immediately follow Z. Y cannot be last. Determine every valid processing order, then state how the set changes if Y is allowed to be last.

Two identical closed containers hold the same ideal gas at the same initial temperature. Container A is compressed slowly while staying in thermal contact with a large heat bath; container B is compressed rapidly and insulated. Both finish at the same smaller volume. Which container has the higher final pressure, and why? State the relevant thermodynamic paths.

Write a Python function stable_partition(values, predicate) that returns a new list containing every element for which predicate is true followed by every remaining element, preserving relative order within both groups. Do not mutate values, evaluate predicate exactly once per element, and support any iterable.
